prompt: Create a warm, realistic lifestyle photo of a romantic sunrise picnic on a hilltop overlook, featuring a young East Asian couple sitting on a beige blanket under a large leafy tree. Use an unpolished candid-photo feel rather than a perfect studio look, with soft grain, realistic skin texture, slightly deep shadows under the tree canopy, and backlit golden-hour atmosphere. Foreground picnic objects should include exactly 13 visible discrete items: 2 gray mugs, 1 plate of green grapes and oranges, 1 open handwritten journal on a wooden tray table with 1 pen laid across it, 1 open laptop at the lower right, 1 framed handwritten sign reading TODAY: - WORK A LITTLE - CREATE A LITTLE - LOVE A LOT ♡, 1 black travel journal labeled Lam & Ty Wild Journey, 1 white book labeled THE PATTERN, 1 camera at the lower left edge, 1 lit candle in a glass jar, 1 small glass bottle, and 1 folded cloth napkin. Compose in vertical 4:5 portrait orientation, couple placed left-center, sun and hazy landscape filling the right side, intimate peaceful mood, cinematic documentary photography, shallow depth of field, warm amber color grading, natural imperfections, no extra people, no watermark.
